i1.title: Dolce & Gabbana K Eau de Parfum 100ml Gift Set with After Shave Balm and Shower Gel
i1.descriptionHtml:
A regal, citrus-bright K with grooming essentials to match.

Dolce & Gabbana K Eau de Parfum 100ml Gift Set with After Shave Balm and Shower Gel brings together K by Dolce & Gabbana Eau de Parfum with a matching after shave balm and shower gel. Sicilian lemon, blood orange, juniper and cardamom open brightly, a heart of fig, lavender, geranium and clary sage follows, and it settles on cedar, patchouli, vetiver and cypriol.

  • K After Shave Balm 50ml
  • K Shower Gel 50ml

  • Top: Sicilian Lemon, Blood Orange, Juniper Berries, Cardamom
  • Heart: Fig, Lavender, Geranium, Clary Sage
  • Base: Cedar, Patchouli, Vetiver, Cypriol

Key details

  • Brand: Dolce & Gabbana
  • Concentration: Eau de Parfum
  • Contents: K Eau de Parfum 100ml + K After Shave Balm 50ml + K Shower Gel 50ml
  • Scent profile: Citrus · Aromatic · Woody
  • Wear: Men

Why you'll love it

  • A sparkling citrus opening of lemon and blood orange
  • An aromatic heart of fig, lavender and sage
  • A deep woody base of cedar, vetiver and patchouli
  • A complete grooming gift for him

FAQ

What does K by Dolce & Gabbana smell like?

Sicilian lemon, blood orange, juniper berries and cardamom first, then fig, lavender, geranium and clary sage, finishing with cedar, patchouli, vetiver and cypriol.

What's in the set?

K Eau de Parfum 100ml (spray); K After Shave Balm 50ml; K Shower Gel 50ml.

Is it for men?

Yes, it is a men's fragrance gift set.
